title: SourceAsset
description: One ingested asset: original media plus hash, technical metadata, ownership, consent, licence (PRD §5 object table). Carries the complete PRD REQ-004 preflight surface — container, codec, frame rate, VFR behaviour, timebase, rotation, colour space, HDR, audio tracks, sample rate, corruption, duration — inspected BEFORE indexing. The original file is never modified: `proxy` records the derived 720p-fit copy (decisions.md D-25) and `contentHash` addresses the untouched original.

changelog.reason: Initial v1. Models preflight as three always-present, individually-nullable sub-objects (video/audio/corruption) rather than an assetKind-discriminated union: a still image legitimately has no video-stream timing and no audio, and 'null because not applicable' must be distinguishable from 'null because preflight did not run'. Carries sourceClassification (decisions.md D-36) so a fixture can never be counted as Phase 0 exit evidence.

Renamed ProxyRecipe.maxHeight to shortEdgeMaxPixels. D-25's "720p-fit" bounds the SHORT edge; the old name asserted height and was wrong for every portrait source — the exact orientation Phase 0 produces. Burned deliberately while zero real ContentPackages exist, per developer-guide §4 ('burn breaking changes early, not late'): the 'last ten outputs required no breaking contract change' exit criterion counts approved REAL packages, of which there are none, so this rename costs nothing today and would cost a migration later.

Corrected VideoStreamInfo.rotationDegrees from 'clockwise' to counter-clockwise. The original wording was simply wrong about ffprobe's convention; the VALUES produced were always ffprobe-native, so no producer or consumer behaviour changes and nothing on disk is invalidated — which is why this is editorial rather than breaking. Recorded because the error was undetectable at Phase 0 (only the dimension swap consumes it, and 90/270 swap identically) and would have surfaced as a 180°-wrong render much later.

jobId.description: The job this asset was ingested into. Human-chosen (e.g. `test-1`), not a ULID — it is the directory name under `project-data/jobs/`.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the ingest root, in normalized forward-slash form. This is the identity used in error messages and in a job-level rights manifest's keys — REQ-001's discovery order is normalized relative-path order, so this value is also the sort key that makes ingest deterministic.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the ORIGINAL bytes (PRD REQ-005). Together with indexer version and model config this keys every expensive index artefact, so re-ingesting the same footage repeats no work.

storedPath.description: Hash-named location under `project-data/jobs/<job-id>/source/` (tech-spec §9.1). Originals are immutable once written.

preflight.title: PreflightReport
preflight.description: The complete REQ-004 inspection. Every sub-object is REQUIRED to be present; a sub-object is null only when genuinely not applicable to the asset kind (a .srt subtitle has no video and no audio), and `inspected` records that preflight actually ran.

inspected.description: True once ffprobe (or the text-asset reader) completed. A SourceAsset with `inspected: false` never reaches the job inventory — ingest is atomic.

container.description: Null for non-media assets (subtitle, brand reference).

duration.description: Exact duration in rational ticks. This is the upper bound `range-check.ts` validates every Moment and EDL range against — the mechanism behind the 'zero invalid source ranges' exit criterion. Null for assets with no time dimension.

video.description: Null for audio-only, subtitle, and brand-reference assets. Present for image assets (a still is a one-frame video stream to ffprobe).

audioTracks.description: REQ-004 requires audio tracks (plural) and sample rate. An EMPTY array is a positive finding — 'this asset has no audio' — and is what the silent-b-roll fixture asserts. It is never conflated with a null preflight.

proxy.description: The derived proxy (decisions.md D-25), or null when the asset kind has no proxy. The original is never destroyed (REQ-004).

displayWidth.description: Width AFTER applying rotation metadata. Editorial code reads display dimensions only; using coded dimensions on a rotated phone clip silently produces a sideways crop.

rotationDegrees.description: Rotation to apply when displaying, expressed COUNTER-CLOCKWISE — ffprobe's native convention, read from Display Matrix side data (`side_data_list[].rotation`). Direction settled empirically, not from documentation: a half-red/half-blue clip stamped `-display_rotation:v:0 90` lands its LEFT edge at the BOTTOM after autorotation, which is 90° counter-clockwise. This matters because nothing at Phase 0 can observe the difference — only `displayWidth`/`displayHeight` consume it, and 90 and 270 swap dimensions identically — so a renderer that actually applies rotation would be 180° wrong with no earlier test catching it. The legacy container `rotate` tag is CLOCKWISE-positive and is negated on the fallback path (FFmpeg 8 cannot produce that tag, so that branch is untested).

realFrameRate.description: ffprobe's `r_frame_rate`. A material difference from `averageFrameRate` is the primary VFR signal.

timebase.description: The stream's own time base. Every SourceRange into this asset is expressed in THIS timebase, so no float conversion is ever needed (REQ-019).

frameCount.description: Null when the container does not declare it and a full decode was not performed.

hdr.title: HdrInfo
hdr.description: HDR is DETECTED and RECORDED at Phase 0 but not converted — tone-mapping is REQ-089, product Phase 1. Recording it now means the Phase 1 conversion work can find its inputs without a re-ingest.

detectedFormat.description: e.g. `pq` / `hlg`, inferred from the transfer characteristic.

timebase.description: For audio this is `{num: 1, den: sampleRate}`, so ticks ARE sample counts — one representation for frames and samples (see timecode-v1).

ProxyRecord.title: ProxyRecord
ProxyRecord.description: The 720p-fit H.264 CRF 23 + AAC 128k constant-frame-rate proxy (decisions.md D-25). Proxy only — there is no mezzanine tier at Phase 0. Draft renders read this; final renders re-read the source-hashed original (D-34).

proxyProfileVersion.description: Recorded in the SourceIndex per D-25 so a recipe change invalidates the cache rather than silently mixing proxy generations.

shortEdgeMaxPixels.description: D-25's "720p-fit" bound, applied to the SHORT edge — not to height. Reading it as height ≤ 720 would scale a 1080×1920 portrait source to 405×720, a third of the pixels, for a product whose entire Phase 0 output is 9:16 vertical. Short-edge gives 720×1280 portrait and 1280×720 landscape. The two readings coincide for landscape, which is exactly why the misnomer would have survived unnoticed.

timebase.description: The proxy's own (constant) timebase. VFR sources are normalized here; the SourceIndex carries the explicit source-to-proxy mapping REQ-019 demands.
